Refund and Cancellation Policy

Entity: Harion Research (Udyam: UDYAM-MP-22-0035155) · Effective: 29 November 2025

This Refund and Cancellation Policy applies to all educational programs and services offered by Harion Research (3rd Floor, Silver Sanchora, R.N.T. Marg, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001), including the Equity Research Internship Program (duration: 60 days, fee: Free to enroll (Certificate ₹500 optional)), Portfolio Manager Program, and NISM Series VIII Preparation.

  1. Cancellation window: Cancellation requests are considered only if submitted in writing within 2 days (48 hours) of placing the order. Requests will not be entertained if access to digital classroom content, recorded modules, sessions or learning resources has already been provided or the cohort has commenced. After that point, the enrolment is final.
  2. Digital educational content: Cancellations and refunds are not accepted for digital educational modules, recorded sessions, research material, or the Equity Research Internship Program once accessed or initiated. In exceptional cases where a participant demonstrates that the service was not provided as described or suffered an unresolvable technical defect, the matter will be reviewed.
  3. Technical issues: For technical issues such as non-receipt of login credentials, inability to access the platform or duplicate payment charges, report to support within 2 days of purchase. After verification, resolution may include restoring access or issuing a refund, at the discretion of Harion Research.
  4. Service discrepancy: If you believe the educational service delivered materially differs from the description on our website, notify us within 2 days of receiving access so our team can review the stage of delivery and resolve the issue.
  5. Refund processing timeline: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
